title: Subquartic free energy requires ultraviolet-shell covariance

shell_covariance.data: Let nu=rho mu have mean m and covariance S in real cutoff coordinates; put T_N=Tr(P_N Lambda S), C_sh,N=Tr(P_N Lambda)>=kappa C_N and P_N Lambda^2 Omega^(-1)P_N<=a_N P_N Lambda with a_N<=L N^(-2)
shell_covariance.matrix_bound: K1530's Frobenius factorization and K1533 give q0[psi]>=delta_N^2/(4a_N T_N) for every finite-Fisher density and arbitrary phase; no Gaussian likelihood or covariance commutation is assumed
shell_covariance.quartic_floor: Since T_N<=C_sh,N/2=O(N^2), C_sh,N=Theta(N^2) and a_N=O(N^-2), the low-shell-covariance branch has q0[psi]>=cN^4
shell_covariance.necessary_covariance: Consequently q0[psi]=o(N^4), in particular q0[psi]=O(N^2), forces T_N>C_sh,N/2>=kappa C_N/2 for all sufficiently large N
shell_covariance.mean_guard: The requirement concerns centered shell covariance T_N; a large coherent mean or a random global plus/minus well in the constant mode cannot supply it
shell_covariance.scope_guard: The theorem is a necessary covariance condition for subquartic free energy, not a sufficient low-energy construction and not an interaction lower bound for all states
